name: Tourmaline Phial
summary: At the Pools of Arlithrien, travelers gather blessed moonwell water in the Tourmaline Phial for Teldrassil's rituals.

sections.title: Vessel of Arlithrien
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage gives travelers the Tourmaline Phial for rituals that tend the World Tree. Druids in Dolanaar use gemstone vials to gather pure moonwell water across Teldrassil. This phial is for the moonwell beside the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the road to Darnassus. Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs are growing more troublesome there.

faq.q: What is the Tourmaline Phial used for?
faq.answer: The Tourmaline Phial gathers sacred water from the moonwell at the Pools of Arlithrien. Once it is full, you return it to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar for the Crown of the Earth rituals.

aliases: where do i get tourmaline phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, gives travelers the empty phial.

faq.q: Where is the moonwell for this phial?
faq.answer: The moonwell lies beside the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the main gateway to Darnassus.

angles.text: As a druid, you carry a gemstone phial to gather moonwell water. It is a ceremonial duty as you learn to tend Teldrassil's fragile ecosystem.
As a night elf, you know moonwell water reflects your people's reliance on Elune's grace and druidic vigilance. Teldrassil struggles against corruption.
